sloka: मन्ये प्रीति विशिष्टा सा मत्तः लक्ष्मण सारिका ।यस्याः तत् श्रूयते वाक्यम् शुक पादम् अरेर् दश ॥२-५३-२२॥
transliteration: manye prīti viśiṣṭā sā mattaḥ lakṣmaṇa sārikā ।yasyāḥ tat śrūyate vākyam śuka pādam arer daśa ॥2-53-22॥

translations.english: (On hearing my banishment) her myna would say to her parrot, 'O parrot, bite the foot of the enemy (Kaikeyi)'. I think that bird is a greater source of joy to my mother than I, O Lakshmana
